subject: Model formula that automatically allows correlations between a subset of variables

messages.author: 1c630d2c74eed22c
messages.subject: Model formula that automatically allows correlations between a subset of variables
parts:
I have a measurement model with some observed independent variables. I would like to describe a model in which the error terms of the variables associated with the latent variables are independent ... but the independent variables are allowed to have correlations. Since there are a lot of these, I don't want to write them out explicitly. A simple example of the model is the following:

f1 ~= x1+x2+x3

f1 ~ y1+y2+y3

y1 ~~ y2
y1 ~~ y3
y2 ~~ y3

But in my case, I have 3 latent factors and about 6 observed dependents, so I would like a shortcut, if possible

Thanks.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Model formula that automatically allows correlations between a subset of variables
parts: I believe all you need to do to automatically estimate covariances among exogenous predictors is to include the argument "fixed.x = FALSE" in your call to lavaan(), sem(), or cfa().
